summary: Nova Minds is a first-person 3D space mission game where players walk through a space center, build a satellite from real spacecraft parts, launch it and operate it over a live solar system built from NASA/JPL data. Guided by specialist crew members and VEGA, an AI cyborg advisor, players learn how NASA designs missions, balancing mass, power, cost and data across the launch, space, ground and user segments.
details: ova Minds is a first-person 3D space mission simulation. Players explore a space center, assemble a satellite from real spacecraft components, launch it and operate it within a live solar system based on NASA/JPL data. Specialist crew members and VEGA, an AI cyborg advisor, guide them through the process. Along the way, players learn how NASA designs missions, balancing mass, power, cost and data return across the launch, space, ground and user segments.
